# Shirin Shila — Official Cinema Portfolio & Casting Desk

> Official portfolio of Bangladeshi silver-screen film actress, television reality show judge, and model Shirin Shila (Shirin Akter).

## Overview
Shirin Shila is an acclaimed Dhallywood film actress based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. She debuted in 2014 in the blockbuster feature "Hitman" alongside superstar Shakib Khan, earned the Babisas Best Actress Award in 2019 for "Begum Jaan", starred in historical liberation war cinema "Birangona 71", and continues to headline high-profile films such as "Shesh Baji" (2024), "Ghor Vanga Songsar", and "Jimmi". Beyond cinema, she serves as a celebrity judge on nationwide television reality competitions and acts as a cultural brand ambassador.

## Core Filmography
- **Hitman (2014)**: Silver-screen debut opposite Shakib Khan; action-romance directed by Wazed Ali Sumon; nominated for Meril-Prothom Alo Awards.
- **Begum Jaan (2019)**: Title lead role; dramatic performance directed by Mohammad Aslam; Winner of Babisas Best Actress Award.
- **Birangona 71 (2022)**: Historical 1971 Liberation War patriotic drama directed by M. Sakhawat Hossain.
- **Shesh Baji (2024)**: Psychological suspense thriller directed by Mehedi Hasan.
- **Ghor Vanga Songsar (2023)**: Family socio-drama directed by Montazur Rahman Akbar.
- **Jimmi (2023)**: Action-thriller directed by Monowar Hossain Dipjol.
